propositions: CompletionAgentStep.run catches only UnretryableOutputError, but step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError (a strict ancestor), making bounded recovery unreachable when budget is exhausted
LLMRunnerError and UnretryableOutputError both carry identical usage_log.failure_usage diagnostic dicts, preventing reliable identification of budget exhaustion by shape sniffing alone
Bounded recovery mechanism must engage on budget exhaustion to isolate criteria in fresh agentic history and converge evidence run at 16 steps with tool-free structured finalizer
Adding LLMBudgetExhaustedError as a typed subclass of LLMRunnerError enables type-based routing without message or diagnostic sniffing, maintaining backward compatibility
When budget exhaustion recovery also fails, the original budget diagnostic must be preserved on failure_diagnostic to retain counters for operator surfacing
